units.source: Morale has six states and represents the mental condition of combatants and their effectiveness in battle. Unbreakable state is exclusive to {#1}Undead{/#1}, and can not be changed. Steady is the default state, and non-undead enemies start with it and it can raise and lower as they pass or fail morale checks. Brothers' morale depends on their {#2}mood{/#2}: good mood gives a chance to start with Confident morale, and bad mood lowers the maximum possible level of morale the brother can have. Some {#3}traits{/#3} also affect starting morale or its maximum.
units.zh: 士气分为六种状态，反映战斗单位的精神状况，并影响其战斗表现。“不可动摇”状态仅属于{#1}亡灵{/#1}，无法改变。“镇定”是默认状态，非亡灵敌人开战时均处于这一状态；随后通过或未通过士气检定时，士气会升高或降低。佣兵的初始士气取决于其{#2}心情{/#2}：心情好时，有概率以“斗志昂扬”状态参战；心情差则会降低其可达到的士气上限。某些{#3}特性{/#3}也会影响初始士气或士气上限。

units.source: If morale drops to Fleeing, the unit cancels its active {#1}Shieldwall{/#1}, {#2}Spearwall{/#2}, {#3}Riposte{/#3} and {#4}Indomitable{/#4}, is also instantly moved to the end of turn order. At the start of a round Fleeing units have a penalty of -1000 initiative for turn order only, so they will act last, if not under {#5}Adrenaline{/#5}. Fleeing units try to run away from enemies and can't fight or use skills, and even don't fight if surrounded. Player loses control over fleeing brothers. Fleeing units can rally on their own when not adjacent to enemies, or if targeted by skills like {#6}Rally the Troops{/#6} that restore their morale.
units.zh: 士气降至“溃逃”时，该单位会取消正在维持的{#1}盾墙{/#1}、{#2}矛墙{/#2}、{#3}还击架势{/#3}和{#4}不屈{/#4}，并立即移至行动顺序末尾。每轮开始时，溃逃单位在计算行动顺序时承受 -1000 先攻惩罚，因此除非受到{#5}肾上腺素{/#5}影响，否则会最后行动。溃逃单位会尝试远离敌人，无法战斗或使用技能，即使被包围也不会还手；玩家也会失去对溃逃佣兵的控制。当身边没有相邻敌人时，溃逃单位可能自行恢复士气，也可通过{#6}重振士气{/#6}等技能恢复。

units.source: {#1/} {#2}Tactical turn based combat is the heart of Battle Brothers.{/#2} The battlefield is a hex-tiled grid, with elevation, obstacles/terrain considerations and zone of control mechanics. An Action Point (AP) system limits the number of actions (movement, skill use) a unit can take each round and an initiative-based system determines the order in which combatants act out their turns.{#3}{#4}{#5}[{/#5}1{#6}]{/#6}{/#4}{/#3}
units.zh: {#1/}{#2}回合制战术战斗是《战场兄弟》的核心。{/#2}战场由六边形网格组成，并包含高低差、障碍物、地形与控制区域机制。行动点（AP）限制单位每轮能够进行的移动、技能施放等行动次数，先攻则决定各战斗单位的行动顺序。{#3}{#4}{#5}[{/#5}1{#6}]{/#6}{/#4}{/#3}

units.source: The character with the highest initiative will start first in a battle round, followed by characters with lower initiative. As initiative is lowered when a character builds up fatigue or has a penalty to max. fatigue (due to armor/weapons or other effects), his turn may move from first to last very quickly, if he gets fatigued too fast and the enemies do not.
units.zh: 每轮战斗中，先攻最高的角色最先行动，其余角色依先攻高低依次行动。累积疲劳，以及护甲、武器或其他效果造成的疲劳上限惩罚，都会降低先攻。因此，如果一名角色比敌人更快陷入疲劳，他的行动顺序可能很快从最前落到最后。

units.source: AP is spent by actions (moving, striking, using special skills/consumables, etc) and refreshed at the start of the every round. All brothers and most enemy units have 9AP. A few have less (ie Wiedergangers) and some have more (ie Direwolves, Goblin Wolfriders).
units.zh: 移动、攻击、使用特殊技能或消耗品等行动都需要花费行动点，行动点在每轮开始时恢复。所有佣兵和大多数敌人拥有 9 点行动点；少数单位较少，例如行尸；也有单位更多，例如恐狼和地精狼骑手。

units.source: Movement on flat ground (Grass/Plains/Roads) costs 2AP. Rough terrain such as Forest/Snow have tiles that typically cost 3AP (there are tiles that still cost 2AP though (ie Light Snow)). Swamp costs 4AP for tiles with Murky Water. Changing elevation adds a further +1 to AP cost per tile. Most strikes from 1-handed weapons use 4AP (exception: Dagger (with Mastery) uses only 3AP) and strikes from 2-handed weapons use 6AP (exception: Warbrand, Rhomphaia and 2-Handed Cleavers use 4AP on regular strikes; Jagged Pike uses 5AP).
units.zh: 在草地、平原或道路等平坦地面上移动需要 2 点行动点。森林、积雪等崎岖地形通常需要 3 点，但部分地块仍只需 2 点，例如薄雪地块。沼泽中的浑水地块需要 4 点。每跨越一格高低差，行动点消耗额外 +1。大多数单手武器攻击消耗 4 点行动点；例外是学习精通后的匕首攻击，仅消耗 3 点。双手武器攻击通常消耗 6 点；例外是长刃战刀、镰刃长剑和双手砍刀，其普通攻击消耗 4 点，而锯齿长枪消耗 5 点。

units.source: A typical battle starts with both parties in a line formation (1-2 lines deep for your forces, may be deeper for the enemy), with at least 5 hexes between parties. Human forces cannot close to melee distance within 1 round as traversing a hex takes a minimum of 2AP. Direwolves and Goblin Wolfriders on the other hand can definitely close the gap in 1 round. As bows have a range of 7 tiles on the flat (8 with mastery) and crossbows have a range of 6 tiles, both sides start the 1st round within firing distance of ranged combatants.
units.zh: 通常，双方会以线列阵形开战：我方纵深为 1-2 排，敌方可能更深，双方之间至少相隔 5 格。人类单位每移动一格至少需要 2 点行动点，因此无法在 1 轮内接近到近战距离；恐狼和地精狼骑手则能在 1 轮内跨越这段距离。弓在平地上的射程为 7 格，精通后为 8 格；弩为 6 格，因此双方在第 1 轮开始时就已进入远程单位的射程。

units.source: Apart from AP, all weapon strikes and movement on the battlefield also cost fatigue to execute, therefore a fully fatigued character can neither strike nor move. Every character recovers 15 fatigue at the start of his turn. As per full release version 1.1, dodging/blocking blows also increases Fatigue by 2 and getting struck by a blow increases Fatigue by 5.
units.zh: 除了行动点，战场上的所有武器攻击和移动都会累积疲劳，因此疲劳达到上限的角色既不能攻击，也不能移动。每名角色在自己的回合开始时恢复 15 点疲劳。按正式版 1.1 的规则，闪避或格挡一次攻击会累积 2 点疲劳，被攻击命中则累积 5 点。

units.source: Melee units - units with a melee weapon, bare fists, or beasts (except for alps and hexes) - exert a Zone of Control on tiles directly adjacent to them. Any unit trying to leave a tile under Zone of Control will suffer automatic strikes from the hostiles controlling the ZoC (at no fatigue cost for the controlling unit). If all strikes miss, the unit leaves the tile. If any strike hits, the attempt to leave the tile fails and the unit has to try again.
units.zh: 持有近战武器、赤手空拳或属于野兽的单位（梦魇和女巫除外），会对相邻地块施加控制区域。任何单位尝试离开敌方控制区域时，都会遭到控制该地块的敌人自动攻击；发动这种攻击不消耗敌人的疲劳。只有所有攻击都落空，移动单位才能离开；只要有一次命中，本次移动就会失败，必须再次尝试。

units.source: A unit using any kind of ranged weapon (i.e. bow, javelins), a fleeing or stunned unit does not exert a Zone of Control. A smoke pot removes the ZoC from affected tiles for 1 turn. Footwork skill allows to move through ZoC safely. Rotation skill allows a unit to leave the ZoC by swapping positions with another non-hostile unit. Entangled, horrified, and sleeping units lose their ability to exert their ZoC.
units.zh: 持有弓、标枪等远程武器的单位，以及溃逃或眩晕的单位，都不会施加控制区域。烟雾罐能让受影响地块的控制区域失效 1 回合。“灵活步法”允许安全穿越控制区域；“换位”则可通过与另一名非敌对单位交换位置离开。被缠绕、陷入恐惧或处于睡眠中的单位，也会失去施加控制区域的能力。

units.source: Base chance to hit (shown after selecting a skill and mousing over a target) is essentially: melee skill of brother subtracted against base melee defense of target. {#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}2{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: 基础命中率会在选中技能并将鼠标移到目标上时显示，其基本计算方式为：佣兵的近战命中减去目标的基础近战防御。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}2{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: This is further modified by various factors listed below.
units.zh: 这一数值还会受到下列因素的修正。

units.source: Gear, elevation and surround bonuses are factored in additively. (ie an attacker with Melee Skill of 70 striking a defender with Melee Defense of 0 will have 70% hit chance. If said attacker had another friendly unit adjacent/surrounding the defender, he would get +5% or in other words his hit chance would be 75% instead)
units.zh: 装备、高低差和包围加成以加法计入。例如，近战命中为 70 的攻击者攻击近战防御为 0 的目标时，命中率为 70%。如果另有一名友军与目标相邻，形成包围，攻击者就会获得 +5% 命中加成，最终命中率为 75%。

units.source: Morale bonuses/penalties and injury penalties are factored in multiplicatively (ie an archer with 86 Ranged Skill at Steady will have effectively 94 Ranged Skill at Confident (+10%))
units.zh: 士气加成或惩罚，以及伤势惩罚，以乘法计入。例如，一名在士气“镇定”时远程命中为 86 的弓箭手，进入“斗志昂扬”状态后，实际远程命中为 94（+10%）。

units.source: Defense is improved by shields (mentioned below), various perks like Dodge, Shield Expert, Reach Advantage, etc. However, it is also subject to diminishing returns stat-wise at values beyond 50: each Melee Defense attribute point over 50 is halved.{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}3{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1} {#5}{#6}{#7}[{/#7}4{#8}]{/#8}{/#6}{/#5}

When an attack is made, a regular d100 roll happens (a procedure to get a random number in the range of 1 to 100). If the number is lower than the to-hit % chance, then this is a hit. At this point, a second d100 roll is made to see if it the attack hits the head. {#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}5{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: 发动攻击时，系统会进行一次 d100 掷骰，即在 1 到 100 之间随机取一个数。若结果低于命中率对应的数值，攻击就会命中。随后，系统再进行一次 d100 掷骰，判断是否命中头部。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}5{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: Weapons with hit bonuses include, for example, {#1}pitchforks{/#1}, {#2}pikes{/#2} and the {#3}Battle Standard{/#3} with a +10% chance when using the "{#4}Impale{/#4}" skill.
units.zh: 某些武器带有命中加成。例如，{#1}草叉{/#1}、{#2}长枪{/#2}和{#3}战旗{/#3}在使用“{#4}贯刺{/#4}”技能时拥有 +10% 命中率。

units.source: Weapon skills like {#1}Slash{/#1} (+10% hit chance, available for {#2}swords{/#2}) or {#3}Thrust{/#3} (+20% hit chance, available for {#4}spears{/#4})
units.zh: 武器技能也会提供加成，例如{#2}剑类{/#2}的{#1}挥斩{/#1}提供 +10% 命中率，{#4}长矛类{/#4}的{#3}挺刺{/#3}提供 +20% 命中率。

units.source: {#1}Shields{/#1} confer strong defense bonuses which significantly lower the hit chance of anyone attacking someone who has a shield equipped. Examples of standard shields:
units.zh: {#1}盾牌{/#1}提供可观的防御加成，显著降低持盾者遭受攻击时的被命中概率。常见盾牌如下：

units.source: The {#1}Shieldwall{/#1} skill (not available to mercenaries using a {#2}Buckler{/#2} as it is not a "normal" shield) can be used in combat to double shield defense (inclusive of Shield Expert bonus) with a additional +5 bonus for each adjacent ally also using the {#3}Shieldwall{/#3} skill. This tactic can be used to give your front rank mercenaries a big boost to defense when taking a large amount of damage is otherwise inevitable (e.g. needing to advance while under fire from enemy ranged troops).
units.zh: 在战斗中使用{#1}盾墙{/#1}，可使盾牌防御加倍，其中包括盾牌精通带来的加成。每有一名同样使用{#3}盾墙{/#3}的相邻友军，还可额外获得 +5 防御。{#2}小圆盾{/#2}不属于常规盾牌，装备它的佣兵无法使用盾墙。面对难以避免的大量伤害时，例如必须顶着敌方远程火力前进，盾墙能大幅提高前排佣兵的防御。

units.source: The {#1}Knock Back{/#1} skill knocks the target away by 1 tile, costs 4AP, 20 Fatigue, and has a flat +25 to hit bonus. Terrain and surround bonuses apply as usual. However unlike regular strikes, Knock Back does no direct damage and its roll is not displayed in the combat log. If the game will allow you to use an ability against an enemy that is immune, it will then simply miss. This is relevant because one might assume that a pike's repel ability which both knockbacks and staggers would still apply the stagger effect to an immune enemy, it does not.
units.zh: {#1}击退{/#1}能将目标推开 1 格，消耗 4 点行动点和 20 点疲劳，并获得固定 +25 命中加成；地形和包围加成照常生效。与普通攻击不同，击退不会直接造成伤害，其掷骰结果也不会显示在战斗日志中。若游戏允许对免疫击退的敌人使用这一技能，结果只会是落空。这也适用于长枪同时具有击退和踉跄效果的“逼退”：不能因为敌人只免疫击退，就认为它仍会受到踉跄效果；实际上不会。

units.source: Height levels are used as ground elevations (hills) on the battle map. When standing on them, you gain a bonus to hit chance while enemies suffer a penalty to their chance to hit you.
units.zh: 战场地面的高低差以高度层级表示，例如山丘。站在高处时，你对低处敌人的命中率提高，敌人攻击你的命中率则降低。

units.source: Changing height level costs more action points and costs more fatigue than walking on the same height layer. The {#1}Pathfinder{/#1} perk eliminates the action point penalty. The {#2}Pathfinder{/#2} perk is especially useful for polearm or 2H weapon users, as it allows them to change height level and still attack. It is also extremely useful for ranged mercenaries as they gain significant bonuses from having a higher elevation than their targets and the {#3}Pathfinder{/#3} perk facilitates easy repositioning.
units.zh: 跨越高低差比同高度移动消耗更多行动点和疲劳。{#1}探路者{/#1}可取消额外行动点消耗，因此{#2}探路者{/#2}尤其适合长柄武器或双手武器使用者，让他们在跨越高低差后仍能攻击。它对远程佣兵也很有用：高处能带来明显优势，而{#3}探路者{/#3}能帮助他们更轻松地调整位置。

units.source: There are the following types of height level in-game:
units.zh: 游戏中有以下高度层级：

units.source: When standing on a higher height level than your opponent, you gain a +10% chance to hit and they suffer a -10% penalty to hit. It is always advantageous to have the high ground in any battle and the AI will try to occupy the high ground whenever possible, especially their ranged units.
units.zh: 站在比对手更高的位置时，你获得 +10% 命中率，而对手攻击你时承受 -10% 命中率惩罚。因此，占据高地通常更有利。AI 会尽可能争夺高地，尤其是其远程单位。

units.source: Ranged weapons gain an additional hex of range for each level of height and improved hit chance versus targets at a lower height level.
units.zh: 远程武器每高出一个高度层级，射程就增加一格；攻击较低处的目标时，命中率也会提高。

units.source: You only count as being in melee attack range if there is a one level difference of height between opposing characters standing in adjacent hexes. If there are two or more levels of height difference between the hex a character is standing on and an enemy in an adjacent hex, you do not count as being in melee attack range or being in each other's Zone of Control.
units.zh: 相邻地块上的对立角色，只有高度差不超过一层时才处于彼此的近战攻击范围内。若高度差达到两层或更多，即使地块相邻，也不算进入近战攻击范围，双方也不会对彼此施加控制区域。

units.source: Surrounding occurs when two or more units are adjacent to another one they fight against. For each unit after the first surrounding, a bonus of +5% melee hit chance is given to allies attacking the surrounded target. Both allies and enemies are affected by surrounding.{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}6{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1} {#5}Stunned{/#5} brothers or brothers with {#6}Ranged Weapons{/#6} will not contribute to surround bonus.{#7}{#8}{#9}[{/#9}7{#10}]{/#10}{/#8}{/#7} Non-hostile parties, be it Peasants, Mercenaries, Noble House Forces or alike, don't provide surround bonus for your party.
units.zh: 当至少两名单位与同一个敌对目标相邻时，就会形成包围。从第一名之外的每名包围者起，友军对该目标的近战命中率各增加 +5%。这一规则同时适用于敌我双方。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}6{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}{#5}眩晕{/#5}或持有{#6}远程武器{/#6}的佣兵不会提供包围加成。{#7}{#8}{#9}[{/#9}7{#10}]{/#10}{/#8}{/#7}农民、其他佣兵、贵族军队等非敌对第三方部队，也不会为你的战团提供包围加成。

units.source: {#1}Backstabber{/#1} doubles the surrounding bonus to melee hit chance to +10%.
units.zh: {#1}背刺者{/#1}会将包围提供的近战命中加成翻倍至 +10%。

units.source: {#1}Underdog{/#1} negates the surrounding bonus to melee hit chance unless completely surrounded - in that case, the bonus is +5% in total. If an attacker has the Backstabber perk, its effect is negated and the normal surrounding bonus is applied instead.
units.zh: {#1}以少敌多{/#1}能抵消敌人的近战包围命中加成；但若遭到完全包围，敌人仍会获得总计 +5% 加成。如果攻击者拥有背刺者特长，以少敌多会抵消其额外效果，使其只获得普通包围加成。

units.source: Let's study a case. A {#1}Raider{/#1} is surrounded by your mercenaries Diethelm, Tostig and Erik.{#2/} It is Diethelm's turn. Attacking the {#3}Raider{/#3} with his {#4}Handaxe{/#4}, Diethelm benefits from a bonus of +10% hit chance. That is +5% for each ally adjacent to the target after the first. With {#5}Backstabber{/#5}, Diethelm would have benefited from a total bonus of +20% hit chance.{#6/} It is now the turn of Gunther, another of your mercenary. Gunther is not adjacent to the surrounded {#7}Raider{/#7} and attacks him with a {#8}Longaxe{/#8}. He will also benefit from a bonus of +10% hit chance, doubled with {#9}Backstabber{/#9} for the same reasons.{#10/} Finally, your archer Bernhard acts. He attacks the same {#11}Raider{/#11} with a {#12}Hunting Bow{/#12}. Bernhard will not benefit from any bonus because he is using a {#13}Ranged Weapon{/#13}.
units.zh: 举例来说，你的佣兵迪特黑尔姆、托斯蒂格和埃里克包围了一名{#1}强盗劫掠者{/#1}。{#2/}轮到迪特黑尔姆行动时，他用{#4}手斧{/#4}攻击这名{#3}强盗劫掠者{/#3}，可获得 +10% 命中加成，即除第一名包围者外，每名相邻友军各提供 +5%。若迪特黑尔姆拥有{#5}背刺者{/#5}，总加成就会达到 +20%。{#6/}接着轮到另一名佣兵贡特尔。他没有与目标相邻，而是用{#8}长柄斧{/#8}攻击被包围的{#7}强盗劫掠者{/#7}。他同样获得 +10% 命中加成；拥有{#9}背刺者{/#9}时也同样翻倍。{#10/}最后，弓箭手伯恩哈德用{#12}猎弓{/#12}攻击同一名{#11}强盗劫掠者{/#11}。由于使用的是{#13}远程武器{/#13}，他不会获得包围加成。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}NOTE: In case of friendly melee fire such as the two handed axe round swing, the enemy surround modifier works AGAINST you, which is particularly devastating against Weidergangers as they have backstabber. Meaning in the example above if the blue circled brother was to use his two tile pierce attack against the raider below, and thereby also target the brother circled in green. The chance to hit the green brother with friendly fire would likely be higher than that of hitting the enemy bandit, as the surround multiplier of nearby raiders would apply to the friendly fire attack. This is likely an oversight by the devs.
units.zh: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}注意：双手斧的回旋斩等近战误伤，也会套用敌方对友军的包围修正，反而让你更容易打中自己人。面对拥有背刺者的行尸时，这尤其危险。以上图为例，蓝圈佣兵若使用穿透两格的攻击打击下方劫掠者，同时波及绿圈佣兵，那么误伤绿圈佣兵的概率甚至可能高于命中敌人的概率，因为周围劫掠者对绿圈佣兵形成的包围加成也会计入这次误伤。原文作者认为，这可能是开发者的疏漏。

units.source: {#1}Dodge{/#1} gives a bonus equal to 15% of {#2}current{/#2} Initiative to both Melee Defense and Ranged Defense. Note that Dodge loses effectiveness due to certain {#3}{#4}injuries{/#4}{/#3} which affect Initiative and as a mercenary builds up fatigue during battle (accumulated fatigue lowers Initiative). Dodge is also less effective on characters that are wearing heavier types of armor and using heavy weapons (e.g. Fighting Axe) and even shields as your Initiative is lowered based on the fatigue penalty of equipped weapons, shields, armor and by what is being carried in your bags if it has a fatigue penalty (although this penalty is reduced by 50% while said items are in your bags).
units.zh: {#1}闪避{/#1}会为近战防御和远程防御提供相当于{#2}当前{/#2}先攻 15% 的加成。影响先攻的某些{#3}{#4}伤势{/#4}{/#3}，以及战斗中累积的疲劳，都会削弱闪避效果。重甲、重型武器（例如战斧）和盾牌造成的疲劳惩罚，也会降低先攻，使闪避收益减少。背包中带有疲劳惩罚的物品同样会影响先攻，不过物品放在背包中时，这一惩罚降低 50%。

units.source: Shield bonuses to Melee Defense and Ranged Defense can be increased further by using the {#1}Shield Expert{/#1} perk which increases the base defense bonuses of the currently equipped shield by 25%. Unique shields with higher bonuses to defense values make this perk even more potent.
units.zh: {#1}盾牌精通{/#1}能进一步提高盾牌提供的近战防御和远程防御，使当前装备盾牌的基础防御加成增加 25%。独特盾牌若具有更高的基础防御，就能从这一特长中获得更多收益。

units.source: Some weapon masteries increase the to-hit chance of particular attacks of the related weapon (e.g. {#1}Sword Mastery{/#1} gives the {#2}Split{/#2} and {#3}Swing{/#3} attacks available when using a {#4}Greatsword{/#4} or {#5}Warbrand{/#5} a +5% chance to hit).
units.zh: 某些武器精通会提高对应武器特定攻击的命中率。例如，使用{#4}巨剑{/#4}或{#5}长刃战刀{/#5}时，{#1}剑术精通{/#1}会使{#2}劈开{/#2}和{#3}挥击{/#3}的命中率增加 +5%。

units.source: Some other perks give bonuses/maluses to hit chances under specific conditions. They are described in more detail on the {#1}Perks{/#1} page.
units.zh: 其他一些特长会在特定条件下增加或降低命中率，详见{#1}特长{/#1}页面。

units.source: Battle Brothers uses a day/night cycle, going through the following phases
units.zh: 《战场兄弟》的昼夜循环依次经过以下阶段：

units.source: Battles fought during the night give combatants the {#1}{#2}{#3}Nighttime{/#3}{/#2}{/#1} debuff which gives them penalties of -2 Vision, -30% Ranged Skill and -30% Ranged Defense (if not immune to the effects - e.g. having {#4}The Fangshire{/#4} helmet equipped). As Ranged Skill for both AI ranged troops and human-controlled mercenaries generally tends to be significantly higher than Ranged Defense in most cases, this usually works out in favor of the defender. Thus it is advantageous to attack enemies which have ranged superiority during Nighttime.
units.zh: 夜间作战时，战斗单位会受到{#1}{#2}{#3}夜间{/#3}{/#2}{/#1}减益，承受 -2 视野、-30% 远程命中和 -30% 远程防御惩罚；免疫夜间效果的单位除外，例如装备{#4}獠牙乡{/#4}头盔的角色。无论 AI 远程部队还是玩家佣兵，其远程命中通常明显高于远程防御，所以这些修正总体上往往更有利于防守方。因此，对抗远程火力占优的敌人时，夜间进攻通常更有利。

units.source: Ranged to-hit rolls operate in the same manner as melee to-hit rolls, where to-hit = Ranged Skill of brother subtracted by base Ranged Defense of target. A few additional factors come into play though, besides the usual gear and perk considerations, namely:
units.zh: 远程命中掷骰与近战基本相同：基础命中率等于佣兵的远程命中减去目标的基础远程防御。不过，除了通常的装备和特长因素，还需要考虑以下因素：

units.source: Regular {#1}bows{/#1} suffer -4% accuracy per hex with {#2}Quickshot{/#2} (no base accuracy bonus){#3/}
units.zh: 普通{#1}弓类{/#1}使用{#2}速射{/#2}时，每格距离承受 -4% 命中率惩罚，技能本身不提供基础命中加成。{#3/}

units.source: Regular {#1}bows{/#1} suffer -2% accuracy per hex with {#2}Aimed Shot{/#2} (offset by a +10% base accuracy bonus){#3/}
units.zh: 普通{#1}弓类{/#1}使用{#2}瞄准射击{/#2}时，每格距离承受 -2% 命中率惩罚，同时获得 +10% 基础命中加成。{#3/}

units.source: {#1}Crossbows{/#1} suffer -3% accuracy per hex when using the {#2}Shoot Bolt{/#2} skill (offset by +15% base accuracy bonus for the Shoot Bolt skill (only +10% base accuracy bonus if using a {#3}Spiked Impaler{/#3})){#4/}
units.zh: {#1}弩类{/#1}使用{#2}弩矢射击{/#2}时，每格距离承受 -3% 命中率惩罚，同时获得 +15% 基础命中加成；若使用{#3}刺桩重弩{/#3}，基础命中加成只有 +10%。{#4/}

units.source: The first hex from the bowman is NOT counted and does not give penalties for the purposes of to-hit chance calculations.{#1/}
units.zh: 计算弓的距离命中惩罚时，不计射手身旁的第一格，因此这一格不会带来惩罚。{#1/}

units.source: Examples:{#1/}(a.) {#2}Aimed Shot{/#2} by a Ranged Skill 50 bowman on a {#3}Bandit Thug{/#3} with a Ranged Defense skill of 0 who is 7 hexes away, will have 50% + 10% (Aimed Shot) - 12% (accuracy degradation of 2 for 6 hexes of distance) = 48% to-hit chance.{#4/}(b.) {#5}Shoot Bolt{/#5} by a Ranged Skill 50 crossbowman on a {#6}Bandit Thug{/#6} with a Ranged Defense skill of 0 who is 6 hexes away using a {#7}Light Crossbow{/#7}, will have 50% + 15% chance for {#8}Shoot Bolt{/#8} - 15% (accuracy degradation of 3 for 5 hexes of distance) = 50% to-hit chance.
units.zh: 例如：{#1/}（a.）一名远程命中为 50 的弓箭手，使用{#2}瞄准射击{/#2}攻击 7 格外、远程防御为 0 的{#3}强盗暴徒{/#3}，命中率为 50% + 10%（瞄准射击） - 12%（计入 6 格距离，每格降低 2） = 48%。{#4/}（b.）一名远程命中为 50 的弩手，使用{#7}轻弩{/#7}的{#5}弩矢射击{/#5}攻击 6 格外、远程防御为 0 的{#6}强盗暴徒{/#6}，命中率为 50% + 15%（{#8}弩矢射击{/#8}） - 15%（计入 5 格距离，每格降低 3） = 50%。

units.source: Thrown weapons (e.g. {#1}Bundle of Javelins{/#1}) suffer a penalty of -10% accuracy per hex (offset by a +30% base accuracy bonus). Note that, unlike bows and crossbows, thrown weapons DO count the first hex from the attacker for distance effects on accuracy.
units.zh: 投掷武器，例如{#1}标枪束{/#1}，每格距离承受 -10% 命中率惩罚，同时获得 +30% 基础命中加成。与弓和弩不同，投掷武器计算距离惩罚时，会计入攻击者身旁的第一格。

units.source: 2. {#1}Cover{/#1} (shown as "Line of fire blocked" with it's own unique icon of a shield with an arrow) reduces overall to-hit chance by 75%. This penalty can be reduced to 50% by the {#2}Bullseye{/#2} perk. In the above example (a.), the bowman would only have a 12% to-hit chance on the {#3}Bandit Thug{/#3} if he had cover (e.g he was standing behind another enemy unit or was behind one of your own units. This chance would be improved to 24% with the {#4}Bullseye{/#4} perk making it a core pick for ranged mercenaries.
units.zh: 2. {#1}掩体{/#1}会使总体命中率降低 75%；界面上显示为“射线受阻”，并配有盾牌和箭矢图标。{#2}鹰眼{/#2}可将这一惩罚降低至 50%。以上面的例子（a.）为例，若{#3}强盗暴徒{/#3}处于掩体后方，例如另一名敌人或你的佣兵挡在前方，弓箭手的命中率就只有 12%。学习{#4}鹰眼{/#4}后可提高至 24%，因此它是远程佣兵的重要选择。

units.source: The initial roll on whether the shot hits the intended target or its 'Cover' (which could be another unit or an inanimate obstacle) is NOT shown on the battle log though as of release 1.1. The battle log ONLY displays the to-hit roll for the intended or unintended target, without factoring in Cover a second time.{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}8{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: 截至正式版 1.1，系统首先判断这一箭会射向预定目标，还是射向充当掩体的单位或障碍物；这次判定不会显示在战斗日志中。日志只显示随后针对实际目标的命中掷骰，不会再次计入掩体。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}8{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: Ranged attacks confer the debuff granted by the {#1}Overwhelm{/#1} perk to any target struck even if it is not the intended target (e.g. hit on another target due to the scatter mechanic for ranged attacks) or even by a miss on the intended target.
units.zh: 远程攻击命中的任何目标都会受到{#1}压制{/#1}特长带来的减益，即使该目标并非原本瞄准的对象，例如因散射而被击中的其他单位。即使攻击未命中原定目标，也能对原定目标施加压制。

units.source: As with Melee Defense, the {#1}Dodge{/#1} perk and shields also affect Ranged Defense, as does height advantage/disadvantage. The {#2}Anticipation{/#2} perk confers a bonus to Ranged Defense based on the distance from the attacker and on the base Ranged Defense of the defender. The farther the distance from the attacker, the bigger of a bonus {#3}Anticipation{/#3} provides to Ranged Defense. Some enemy units have access to these perks as well (e.g. {#4}Goblin Ambushers{/#4} have the {#5}Anticipation{/#5} perk).
units.zh: 与近战防御一样，{#1}闪避{/#1}、盾牌和高低差都会影响远程防御。{#2}预判{/#2}则根据攻击者的距离以及防守者的基础远程防御，提供额外远程防御；攻击者越远，{#3}预判{/#3}提供的加成越高。某些敌人也拥有这些特长，例如{#4}地精伏击者{/#4}就拥有{#5}预判{/#5}。

units.source: 3. Scatter is a mechanic whereby a missed ranged attack has a chance to strike an adjacent target, friendly or enemy. Because of scatter, it can be effective to fire into a block of enemy units even if your hit chance on your intended target is low for whatever reason (e.g. due to the line of fire being blocked, due to low ranged skill or due to distance). In this circumstance, you have a reasonable chance to hit {#1}something{/#1} (hopefully an enemy!).{#2/}
units.zh: 3. 散射是指远程攻击未命中后，有概率击中目标相邻的其他单位，无论敌我。因此，即使命中预定目标的概率因射线受阻、远程命中较低或距离过远而不高，向密集敌群射击仍可能有效：你仍有不小的机会打中{#1}某个目标{/#1}，希望那是敌人。{#2/}

units.source: Ranged attacks via the scatter mechanic can actually strike unintended targets one hex beyond the normal maximum range of the attack in question.
units.zh: 远程攻击发生散射时，甚至可能击中正常最大射程以外一格的非预定目标。

units.source: When the target of a skill is hit (intentionally or not) it will receive damage. There are two main types of damage:
units.zh: 技能命中目标时，无论是否原本瞄准该目标，都会造成伤害。伤害主要分为两类：

units.source: Each type is rolled separately. Damage dealt and received depends on several factors including the weapon and skill used as well as perks, traits and other modifiers. Armor absorbs and reduces damage taken. This is a simplified formula for calculating armor and hitpoints damage:
units.zh: 两类伤害分别掷骰计算。造成和承受的伤害取决于所用武器、技能、特长、特质及其他修正。护甲能够吸收并降低伤害。以下是计算护甲伤害与生命值伤害的简化公式：

units.source: For example, using a {#1}Billhook{/#1} to attack an {#2}Orc Warrior{/#2} wearing a Looted Kettle Hat (300) and a Looted Scale Armor (280). The weapon base damage is 60-90, 30% of it ignores armor for 18-27 hp damage and it has 150% effectiveness against armor for 90-135 armor damage
units.zh: 例如，用{#1}钩镰{/#1}攻击一名穿着掠夺来的铁盔（300 护甲）和鳞甲（280 护甲）的{#2}兽人战士{/#2}。武器基础伤害为 60-90，其中 30% 可以穿透护甲，造成 18-27 生命值伤害；破甲效率为 150%，因此可造成 90-135 护甲伤害。

units.source: Orc Warrior is hit in the head (critical hit), resulting in +50% HP damage
units.zh: 兽人战士被击中头部，触发暴击，生命值伤害增加 +50%。

units.source: Orc Warrior takes 27 - 18 (10% of remaining armor) = 9 * 1.5 = 13 damage to hitpoints
units.zh: 兽人战士承受的生命值伤害为：27 - 18（剩余护甲的 10%） = 9 * 1.5 = 13。

units.source: Secondary damage (bleeding, miasma, etc.) usually bypasses armor and deals a constant amount of damage which can be mitigated with skills like Indomitable.
units.zh: 流血、瘴气等次生伤害通常会绕过护甲，造成固定数值的伤害；不屈等技能可以减轻这类伤害。

units.source: {#1}Two-Handed Axes'{/#1} {#2}{#3}Split Man{/#3}{/#2} skill has specific mechanics. The fact that it hits the head on a successful attack has mislead many players into thinking that it always does critical damage.
units.zh: {#1}双手斧{/#1}的{#2}{#3}劈身{/#3}{/#2}具有特殊机制。由于它在攻击命中时一定会打到头部，许多玩家误以为它必定造成暴击伤害。

units.source: In fact, Split Man has a standard chance to land a critical hit. If it does, the first strike will hit the head and deal critical damage. If not, the second strike will hit the head for half damage (armor and hitpoints). The second strike always deals half damage whether it hits the body or the head. The second strike can never be a critical hit, do critical damage or benefit from skills that increase critical damage like {#1}Chop{/#1} or {#2}Brute trait{/#2}.
units.zh: 实际上，劈身的暴击概率与普通攻击相同。如果触发暴击，第一段攻击就会命中头部并造成暴击伤害；否则，第二段攻击会命中头部，但护甲伤害和生命值伤害都减半。无论命中身体还是头部，第二段攻击始终只造成一半伤害，绝不会暴击，也无法从{#1}劈砍{/#1}或{#2}蛮力特质{/#2}等提高暴击伤害的效果中获益。

units.source: Weapon durability is important, as when a weapon's or {#1}shield's{/#1} durability reaches zero, the weapon or shield will break.
units.zh: 武器和{#1}盾牌{/#1}的耐久度十分重要：耐久降为零时，装备就会损坏。

units.source: Melee weapon durability is lowered by 3 when it strikes armor that has at least 50 durability remaining; weapons are never damaged when they hit flesh (Hitpoints). Durability loss for AoE strikes is calculated separately for each individual hit (ie a Warscythe can lose 9 durability on using Reap, if 3 targets are successfully struck and all 3 hits connect with armor).
units.zh: 近战武器击中剩余耐久至少为 50 的护甲时，会损失 3 点耐久；若直接命中肉体、造成生命值伤害，则不会磨损。范围攻击会分别计算每次命中的耐久损耗。例如，战镰使用收割同时命中 3 个目标，且 3 次都击中护甲时，可能损失 9 点耐久。

units.source: Shield durability is lowered if it is hit by Ranged weapon projectile (bolt/arrow, throwing weapon), by being hit with the Split Shield skill of a weapon (the shield damage will vary based on the weapon doing the splitting) or by randomly being hit with any melee weapon or beast attack when the attempted attack fails but doesn't miss and hits the shield instead (-1 durability for each hit, regardless of weapon).{#1/}The {#2}Shield Expert{/#2} Perk reduces the incoming shield damage by half (50%) to a minimum of one, while the {#3}Axe Mastery{/#3} increases axes' Split Shield damage to shields by 50%.
units.zh: 盾牌被箭矢、弩矢或投掷武器命中，或受到劈盾技能攻击时，会损失耐久；劈盾伤害取决于所用武器。普通近战武器或野兽攻击若未命中角色、却击中盾牌，也会使盾牌损失耐久，每次 -1，与武器种类无关。{#1/}{#2}盾牌精通{/#2}可将受到的盾牌伤害减半（50%），但最低仍为一点；{#3}斧术精通{/#3}则使斧类劈盾技能的盾牌伤害增加 50%。

units.source: {#1}Bow{/#1} or {#2}Crossbow{/#2} durability is lowered by 2 with each shot.

Morale states apply multipliers to some {#1}attributes{/#1} as shown below. They count after additive bonuses from skills, perks and equipment, affecting them as well. Some states are indicated by icons.
units.zh: 各士气状态会对部分{#1}属性{/#1}施加下表所示的倍率修正。这些修正在技能、特长和装备提供的加算加成之后计算，因此也会影响这些加成。部分士气状态会显示对应图标。

units.source: Morale is a combat mechanic that models bravery and cowardice to make battles more real. Breaking the enemy morale is one of possible ways to win a battle.
units.zh: 士气是一种表现勇气与怯懦的战斗机制，让战斗更贴近真实。击溃敌人士气，也是赢得战斗的一种方式。

units.source: Morale checks are dice rolls to change morale or resist an effect. They are not shown in the combat log. Resolve is the base chance to succeed. The maximum chance to succeed is 95% (5% chance to fail), but minimum is 0% (always fail). Some morale checks are mental attacks against which {#1}Witchhunters{/#1}, {#2}Undead Trophy{/#2}, {#3}Protective Runes and Sigils{/#3} and {#4}Mad{/#4} trait are effective and {#5}Superstitious{/#5} is vulnerable. Positive checks raise morale by one level, negative ones lower it by one level, but there are exceptions.
units.zh: 士气检定通过掷骰决定士气变化或是否抵抗某种效果，结果不会显示在战斗日志中。意志是检定成功率的基础；成功率最高为 95%，即至少有 5% 失败概率，最低可降至 0%，即必定失败。部分士气检定属于精神攻击，{#1}猎巫人{/#1}背景、{#2}亡灵战利品项链{/#2}、{#3}护佑符文与法印{/#3}及{#4}疯狂{/#4}特质可提高抵抗能力，而{#5}迷信{/#5}特质会使角色更易受到影响。通常，正向检定使士气提升一级，负向检定使其降低一级，但也有例外。

units.source: A unit is unaffected by morale (displayed as Unbreakable).
units.zh: 单位不受士气影响，显示为“不可动摇”。

units.source: The chance to succeed is more than 500% before it is capped. Same as being unaffected by morale, positive checks also don't work.
units.zh: 成功率在套用上限前已超过 500%。这种情况等同于不受士气影响，正向检定也不会生效。

units.source: Positive check tries to change Fleeing to Breaking (it fails).
units.zh: 正向检定尝试将“溃逃”提升至“濒临崩溃”时，检定失败。

units.source: Positive check tries to raise morale of the brother on the map egde (it fails).
units.zh: 正向检定尝试提高位于地图边缘的佣兵士气时，检定失败。

units.source: Must not be next to enemies. Morale becomes Wavering on success.
units.zh: 身边不能有相邻敌人；检定成功后，士气变为“动摇”。

units.source: Only rolled when number of adjacent enemies exceeds its maximum on this turn.
units.zh: 只有相邻敌人数超过本回合此前的最高值时，才进行检定。

units.source: Can't raise morale above Steady. Fleeing changes to Wavering on success.
units.zh: 士气最高只能恢复至“镇定”；若原先处于“溃逃”，检定成功后变为“动摇”。

units.source: Raises morale to Steady, or from Steady to Confident.
units.zh: 将士气提升至“镇定”；若已处于“镇定”，则提升至“斗志昂扬”。

units.source: 2-3 morale checks on each target. The order is: first check, {#1}Shellshocked{/#1} is inflicted, second check, damage (15 or higher causes third check).
units.zh: 每个目标进行 2-3 次士气检定，顺序为：第一次检定、施加{#1}炮击震荡{/#1}、第二次检定、造成伤害；若伤害达到 15 或以上，再进行第三次检定。

units.source: {#1}The character's level is a value between 1 and 11 and measures experience in battle. Characters rise in levels as they gain experience and are able to increase their attributes and gain perks that make them better at the mercenary profession.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}角色等级介于 1 至 11 之间，用于衡量战斗经验。角色积累经验后可以升级、提高属性并获得特长，从而成为更出色的佣兵。{/#1}

units.source: As {#1}mercenaries{/#1} fight and gain experience they will level up. With each level your brothers gain they receive a {#2}perk{/#2} point and can increase three different {#3}attributes{/#3}.
units.zh: {#1}佣兵{/#1}通过战斗积累经验并升级。每升一级，就会获得一个{#2}特长{/#2}点，并可提高三项不同的{#3}属性{/#3}。

units.source: The introduction of "Veteran Levels" allows mercenaries to level even farther than level 11. Every level above 11 (= Veteran Level) requires {#1}4000+1000*(current_lvl-11){/#1} XP and there is NO perk point awarded and the stat rolls are reduced to a maximum of +1 for three stats. The actual maximum level is 33 (before DLC "Warriors of the North" it was 42).
units.zh: “老兵等级”允许佣兵在 11 级后继续升级。超过 11 级后，每级所需经验为 {#1}4000+1000*(current_lvl-11){/#1}，不再获得特长点，且只能选择三项属性，每项最多 +1。实际等级上限为 33；《北境勇士》DLC 推出前，上限为 42。

units.source: {#1}Primary Attributes{/#1} can be increased each level by 1-4 points, depending on a character's {#2}talent{/#2}
units.zh: {#1}主要属性{/#1}每级可提高 1-4 点，具体取决于角色的{#2}天赋{/#2}。

units.source: {#1}Secondary Attributes{/#1} can be increased each level by 2-5 points, depending on a character's {#2}talent{/#2}
units.zh: {#1}次要属性{/#1}每级可提高 2-5 点，具体取决于角色的{#2}天赋{/#2}。

units.source: {#1/} Some recruits with military backgrounds may already have a few levels under their belt. If you hire a brother who already has one or more levels, you can distribute his perk points and stat roll level ups after you hired him as you do with a normal mercenary.
units.zh: {#1/}部分具有军旅背景的新兵在招募时就已有一定等级。雇用这类角色后，你可以像培养普通佣兵一样，为其分配此前等级带来的特长点和属性提升。

units.source: Some factors affect the amount of experience points gained in battle:
units.zh: 以下因素会影响战斗中获得的经验值：

units.source: The 'Beginner' combat difficulty grants {#1}+10%{/#1} {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} bonus for every character.
{#1}Training Hall{/#1} services boost the experience gain for a few battles.
units.zh: {#1}训练场{/#1}提供的服务，可提高接下来几场战斗的经验收益。

units.source: {#1}Potion of Knowledge{/#1} gives {#2}+100%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} increase in the next 3 battles and {#6}The King in Chains{/#6} potion provides a permanent {#7}+20%{/#7} {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} boost.
Character trait {#1}Bright{/#1} increases experience gain by {#2}+10%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}, while {#6}Dumb{/#6} characters are penalized by {#7}-15%{/#7} {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}.

{#1}Student{/#1} perk grants additional {#2}20%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}. At the eleventh character level (or at the seventh character level for {#6}Indebted{/#6} when playing the {#7}Manhunters{/#7} origin) the perk becomes inert.
units.zh: {#1}好学{/#1}特长额外提供 {#2}20%{/#2} 经验加成。{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}角色达到十一级后，该特长不再生效；{#7}捕奴者{/#7}起源下的{#6}负债者{/#6}则在七级时失效。

units.source: Some character backgrounds have different modifiers: an {#1}Apprentice{/#1} has {#2}+10%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} and a {#6}Mason{/#6} has {#7}+5%{/#7} {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} innate boost, whereas a {#11}Wildman{/#11} has {#12}-15%{/#12} {#13}{#14}{#15/}{/#14}{/#13} penalty.
{#1}Manhunters{/#1} origin specific rule: any overseer (non-indebted) earns {#2}10%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} less, while any {#6}Indebted{/#6} earns {#7}10%{/#7} {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} more.

Extremely small squads get penalties to experience gain: {#1}-15%{/#1} {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} for two brothers, {#5}-30%{/#5} {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} if there is only one. Brothers in reserve are included, so bringing one brother to a battle and leaving two or more in reserve does not apply the penalty.
units.zh: 人数过少的战团会受到经验惩罚：只有两名佣兵时，经验收益为 {#1}-15%{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}；只有一名时，为 {#5}-30%{/#5}{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6}。预备队也计入人数，因此只派一人参战、另留至少两人在预备队，不会触发这一惩罚。

units.source: A character who dealt the killing blow gets 20% of the XP gained from the enemy. The other 80% is distributed equally among the combat party members.{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}1{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}{#5/}If a Wardog kills an enemy, the XP reward is divided evenly among the combat party brothers.
units.zh: 完成最后一击的角色单独获得该敌人经验值的 20%，其余 80% 由参战成员平均分配。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}1{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}{#5/}若敌人被战犬击杀，则全部经验由参战佣兵平均分配。

units.source: {#1}This article is {#2}outdated{/#2}{/#1}:{#3/}Not all values have been updated since the Blazing Deserts DLC release, and some entries are missing.
units.zh: {#1}本文内容{#2}已过时{/#2}{/#1}：{#3/}部分数值尚未根据《烈日沙漠》DLC 更新，也有条目缺失。

units.source: {#1}For the end formula, see the {#2}Hitpoints Damage{/#2} section{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}最终计算公式见{#2}生命值伤害{/#2}一节。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}For a simplified formula, see the {#2}Damage{/#2} section in {#3}Combat Mechanics{/#3}{/#1}

The game calculates damage in two steps. First the damage dealt by the skill used. Then the damage received by the target. For the sake of clarity this article is divided accordingly. This is a definition of the terms used in some of the formulas:
units.zh: 游戏分两步计算伤害：先计算所用技能造成的伤害，再计算目标实际承受的伤害。为便于理解，本文也按这两个步骤说明。以下是部分公式中所用术语的定义：

units.source: Each variable has a default value that can be modified by one or several modifiers. The value can be multiplied (*), added (+), subtracted (-) or a new value can be set (=). This page lists all usable skills in the game.
units.zh: 每个变量都有默认值，可受一项或多项修正影响。修正方式包括乘法（*）、加法（+）、减法（-）或直接设为新值（=）。本页列出了游戏中可使用的全部技能。

units.source: The result is a multiplier not an amount of damage.
units.zh: 结果是伤害倍率，而非具体伤害数值。

units.source: See {#1}Weapons{/#1} for default values. Some skills and perks can modify the weapon value.
units.zh: 默认数值见{#1}武器{/#1}页面。部分技能和特长可以改变武器数值。

units.source: It seems that direct damage is solely determined by weapon skills. Direct damage modifiers within weapon files are used solely for UI purposes. This means that for example a Goedendag will ignore 25% of armor when using Thrust and 40% when using Knock-Out, although the weapon descriptions states it as ignoring 25% of armor. Possibly, this used to be different.
units.zh: 穿甲伤害似乎完全由武器技能决定，武器文件中的穿甲伤害修正仅用于界面显示。例如，尖头棒的武器说明标注穿甲比例为 25%，但实际使用挺刺时为 25%，使用击晕时为 40%。早期版本可能采用过不同规则。

units.source: Secondary damage ignores armor (unless it specifically targets it like acid). It stacks if applied multiple times. As damage from attacks it can be resisted (see the {#1}Damage Received{/#1} section) but Nimble does not protect against it. All effects are removed after combat.
units.zh: 次生伤害会忽略护甲，专门损伤护甲的酸液等效果除外；同类效果重复施加时可以叠加。与攻击伤害一样，次生伤害也可以被抵抗，详见{#1}承受伤害{/#1}一节，但轻灵无法抵御它。战斗结束后，所有这类效果都会移除。

units.source: Bleeding is caused by {#1}Cleavers{/#1} Cleave Skill, {#2}Jagged Pike{/#2} Rupture Skill and Whips Whip Skill for 5 damage (2 stacks of Bleed for Whips) over 2 turns (3 with the Bleeder Trait). The damage is increased to 10 for Cleave and Whip Skills with the Cleaver Mastery. The minimum (hitpoints) damage necessary for the effect to occur at all is 6.
units.zh: {#1}斩刀类{/#1}的劈斩、{#2}锯齿长枪{/#2}的破裂和鞭子的鞭击都能造成流血，每回合造成 5 点伤害，持续 2 回合；拥有易流血特质时持续 3 回合。鞭击会施加 2 层流血。学习斩刀精通后，劈斩与鞭击的每层流血伤害提高至 10 点。攻击至少造成 6 点生命值伤害，才会触发流血。

units.source: Some {#1}Temporary Injuries{/#1} cause bleeding like damage for the duration of the battle when they were sustained. Grazed Neck deals 1 damage per turn and Cut Artery deals 3. Both these Injuries as well as any bleeding can be cured with {#2}Bandages{/#2} First Aid Skill. Undead are immune to bleeding.
units.zh: 部分{#1}暂时伤势{/#1}会在受伤的这场战斗中持续造成类似流血的伤害：颈部擦伤每回合造成 1 点伤害，动脉割伤造成 3 点。这两种伤势和其他流血效果都可用{#2}绷带{/#2}的急救技能处理。亡灵免疫流血。

units.source: Poison is used by Goblin Ambushers and Webknechts. But only Webknechts poison inflicts damage. Like bleeding, poison is only applied if 7 or more (hitpoints) damage has been dealt. The spider poison deals 5 damage per turn for 3 turns (4 with the Ailing Trait). {#1}Poisoned Oil{/#1} works a bit differently. Webknechts, Undead and some other monsters are immune to the effect.
units.zh: 地精伏击者和巨蛛都会使用毒，但只有巨蛛的毒会造成伤害。类似流血，攻击至少造成 7 点生命值伤害才会施加蛛毒。蛛毒每回合造成 5 点伤害，持续 3 回合；拥有体弱多病特质时持续 4 回合。{#1}淬毒油{/#1}的机制略有不同。巨蛛、亡灵和部分其他怪物免疫这一效果。

units.source: Acid is sprayed over armor when hitting an adjacent Lindwurm for more than 10 damage or by being hit with an {#1}Acid Flask{/#1}. The acidic effect lasts 3 turns and removes 10% of current body (20% with the flask) and head armor (4% with the flask) durability. Lindwurms are immune to the effect. A body armor with the Lindwurm Scale Cloak {#2}Armor Attachment{/#2} is unaffected by it. The {#3}Lindwurm Armor{/#3} and {#4}Lindwurm Helmet{/#4} are also unaffected.
units.zh: 近身攻击林德蠕龙并造成超过 10 点伤害，或被{#1}酸液瓶{/#1}命中时，护甲会沾上酸液。酸蚀持续 3 回合，每回合损失当前身体护甲和头部护甲耐久的 10%；酸液瓶造成的身体护甲损耗为 20%，头部护甲损耗为 4%。林德蠕龙免疫这一效果。装有林德蠕龙鳞披风{#2}护甲附件{/#2}的身体护甲，以及{#3}林德蠕龙护甲{/#3}和{#4}林德蠕龙战盔{/#4}，也不会受到影响。

units.source: This occurs when being pushed down from a height by skills that repel or knock targets back. The damage equals 10 per level difference.
units.zh: 驱退或击退类技能将目标从高处推落时，会造成坠落伤害，每层高度差造成 10 点伤害。

units.source: The damage taken by the caster of the hex is mirrored.
units.zh: 施加诅咒者受到的伤害会同步转移给受诅咒者。

units.source: This skill is used by Alps follows a special formula for damage.
units.zh: 梦魇使用的这一技能采用特殊伤害公式。

units.source: Aimed or Quick Shot, Shoot Bolt or Heavy Bolt
units.zh: 瞄准射击、快速射击、弩矢射击或重弩矢射击

units.source: and if armor is destroyed or direct damage (dealt) = 1
units.zh: 并且，当护甲被摧毁或造成的穿甲伤害系数 = 1 时：

units.source: and the last modifier is applied to the whole
units.zh: 最后，将最终修正应用于整体结果。

units.source: Note than none of the values in each step can be negative. If damage < damage minimum (dealt), damage = damage minimum (dealt).
units.zh: 注意，每一步的数值都不能为负。若伤害 < 造成伤害的最低值，则伤害 = 造成伤害的最低值。

units.source: Our guinea pig is a poor Brigand Raider with the following equipment:
units.zh: 本例的测试对象是一名倒霉的强盗劫掠者，装备如下：

units.source: Sigurd attacks the Raider with Overhead Strike and hits the head! {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 西格德用当头劈斩攻击劫掠者，命中了头部！{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: Sigurd rolls 125 on regular damage! He is Huge and is under a Killing Frenzy! {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 西格德的基础伤害掷骰结果为 125！他拥有高大特质，并处于杀戮狂热状态！{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: Our puny Raider only has 75 hitpoints! His head flies in the air and Sigurd the Beast gleefully adds it to his collection!
units.zh: 这名弱小的劫掠者只有 75 点生命值！他的头颅飞了出去，“野兽”西格德高高兴兴地又添了一件收藏。

units.source: Olaf the Reckless has put himself in deep trouble as usual and is attacked by an Orc Young.
units.zh: “鲁莽者”奥拉夫一如既往地惹上了大麻烦，遭到一名兽人青年的攻击。

units.source: Olaf has 60 hitpoints left of 100 and has the following equipment and skills:
units.zh: 奥拉夫的生命值上限为 100，目前剩余 60；装备和技能如下：

units.source: Head Chopper has a range of 40 - 70 and the Orc Young rolls 60 on regular damage! He uses Decapitate, has Double Grip and a racial bonus! {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 断头斩刀的伤害范围为 40 - 70，兽人青年的基础伤害掷骰结果为 60！他使用斩首，拥有双手握持效果和种族伤害加成！{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: Olaf's Reinforced Mail Hauberk is left with 161 durability! Olaf's armor has Additional Fur Padding! {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 奥拉夫的加固长身锁甲剩余 161 点耐久，而且装有附加毛皮衬垫！{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: Olaf the Reckless makes it this time! Hopefully he'll eventually learn the meaning of his surname!
units.zh: “鲁莽者”奥拉夫这次活了下来！希望他终有一天能明白自己为何会得到这个绰号。

units.source: It has natural armor on body and head (110 durability)
units.zh: 它的身体和头部都拥有天然护甲，耐久为 110。

units.source: Being an ifrit, it has no head, and all attacks always hit its body
units.zh: 沙魔没有头部，因此所有攻击都必定命中其身体。

units.source: Man Splitter has a range of 90 - 120 and Gebhard rolls 120 on regular damage! {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 劈人巨斧的伤害范围为 90 - 120，格布哈德的基础伤害掷骰结果为 120！{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: Gebhard rolls 110 on armor damage! Man Splitter deals 160% damage to armor! {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 格布哈德的护甲伤害掷骰结果为 110！劈人巨斧对护甲造成 160% 伤害！{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: The Ifrit's natural armor is hit for 176 damage and is destroyed! But the armor's durability was 110 which is less, and it is the actual taken damage. The Ifrit takes direct damage! Man Splitter deals 40% damage through armor! {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 沙魔的天然护甲受到 176 点伤害并被摧毁！但护甲原本只有 110 点耐久，因此实际扣除的护甲值也只有这么多。沙魔随后承受穿甲伤害：劈人巨斧有 40% 的伤害可以穿透护甲！{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: Since the armor is zero, the game calculates additional damage! {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 由于护甲已归零，游戏会继续计算额外伤害！{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: The game does not decrease damage when the number is negative, so the Ifrit takes 48 damage to hitpoints. Split Man deals a second damage instance with separate rolls! This attack would normally hit the head, but ifrits have none, and it hits its armorless body instead! Body part damage modifier of the second attack of Split Man is always set to 1, even when it hits the head. {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 若这一计算结果为负，游戏不会据此扣减已有伤害，因此沙魔承受 48 点生命值伤害。劈身还会造成第二段伤害，并单独掷骰！这段攻击通常命中头部，但沙魔没有头部，因此会再次命中已经没有护甲的身体。劈身第二段攻击的部位伤害倍率始终为 1，即使命中头部也是如此。{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: Gebhard rolls 120 on regular damage again! However its damage is halved. {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 格布哈德再次掷出 120 点基础伤害，不过第二段攻击的伤害会减半。{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: Since there is no armor, armor damage roll does not matter and will not affect anything. The Ifrit takes direct damage! {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 由于目标已没有护甲，护甲伤害掷骰不会影响结果。沙魔承受穿甲伤害！{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: Ifrit takes 60 damage from the second part of the attack, and total 108 damage from it. It survives with 2 hitpoints and will probably merge again.
units.zh: 沙魔在第二段攻击中受到 60 点伤害，本次攻击合计造成 108 点伤害。它剩下 2 点生命值，仍然存活，接下来很可能再次合体。

units.source: Note: this only works if the taunted enemy is able to engage the taunting character, ranged or melee. And will be ignored if there is no unobstructed path. While active, the character attracts more attention from enemies and higher Resolve further increases the attraction.
units.zh: 注意：嘲讽只有在敌人能够以近战或远程攻击嘲讽者时才会生效；若没有畅通的接近路径，敌人会无视嘲讽。技能生效期间，角色会更容易吸引敌人注意，意志越高，吸引力越强。

units.source: {#1}Root{/#1} will root up to 7 targets, a rooted target can't move, has {#2}-35%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}, {#6}-35%{/#6} {#7}{#8}{#9/}{/#8}{/#7}, {#10}-35%{/#10} {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} and your chance to break free is your {#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} -10 points with + 10 for each failed attempt (has a range of 8 tiles)

units.zh: {#1}2 级流沙投掷{/#1}造成 70-90 伤害{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}，破甲效率 65%{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}，穿甲比例 40%{#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}。施放的{#11}沙魔{/#11}会分裂成三只较小的{#12}沙魔{/#12}，其中一只出现在投掷目标旁，其余出现在原{#13}沙魔{/#13}附近。无论原{#15}沙魔{/#15}受损多重，新生成的{#14}沙魔{/#14}都会拥有全满的生命值和护甲。技能距离为 2 - 5 格，可在近战中使用，但目标至少须相隔 2 格；可跨越 3 层高度差。

units.source: {#1}Size 3 Throw Living Sand{/#1} does 105-135 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 70% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 40% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, the {#11}Ifrit{/#11} will break down into two size 2 {#12}Ifrits{/#12} and three size 1 {#13}Ifrits{/#13}, one will be right next to the target of the throw and the other 4 next to the original {#14}Ifrit{/#14}, the newly created {#15}Ifrits{/#15} will have full health and armor no matter how damaged the original {#16}Ifrit{/#16} was (Has a range of 2 - 5 tiles, can be used when engaged in melee, but the target has to be at least 2 tiles away, can be used over 3 elevation levels)

{#1}Sleep{/#1} attempts to put a brother to sleep, sleep is like a stun but the brother can be woken up by other brothers or rally the troops skill, can be resisted with a {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} check, after 3 turns the brother will wake up on his own (has a range of 2 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}沉睡{/#1}尝试使一名佣兵睡着。睡眠类似眩晕，但其他佣兵或重振士气技能可以将其唤醒。目标可通过意志{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}检定抵抗，并会在 3 回合后自行醒来。技能距离为 2 格。

units.source: {#1}Spirit Walk{/#1} teleports the ijirok, turns surrounding tiles to snow tiles and {#2}chills{/#2} the brothers next to the teleport (has a range of 1 to 30 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}灵体漫步{/#1}使伊吉罗克传送，将周围地块变为雪地，并使传送位置附近的佣兵{#2}冻寒{/#2}。技能距离为 1 至 30 格。

units.source: {#1}Swallow Whole{/#1} Devours a brother and removes him from the battle until the nachzehrer has died - The brother takes 10-20 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} damage, but will at least emerge with 5 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} remaining - You can't straight up die from being devoured
units.zh: {#1}囫囵吞食{/#1}吞下一名佣兵，使其暂时离开战场，直到食尸鬼死亡。佣兵会受到 10-20 点生命值伤害{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}，但脱困时至少保留 5 点生命值{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}；吞食本身不会直接致死。

units.source: {#1}Tail Slam Sweep{/#1} does 60-120 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 150% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}, 35% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, has {#11}-5%{/#11} chance to hit, will hit up to 3 targets next to each other, causes the target to be {#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} {#15}dazed{/#15} for 2 turns or has knockback or will {#16}{#17}{#18/}{/#17}{/#16} {#19}stun{/#19} for 1 turn

{#1}Tail Slam Thresh{/#1} does 60-120 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 150% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}, 35% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, has {#11}-5%{/#11} chance to hit, will hit up to 6 targets right next to the tail, causes the target to be {#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} {#15}dazed{/#15} for 2 turns or has knockback or will {#16}{#17}{#18/}{/#17}{/#16} {#19}stun{/#19} for 1 turn
{#1}Unstoppable Charge{/#1} will {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}stun{/#5} and {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}stagger{/#9} the target (has a range of 3 tiles)

{#1}Warcry{/#1} bolsters the {#2}Morale{/#2} and reduces the accumulated {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} Fatigue of nearby allies, weakens the {#6}Morale{/#6} of nearby brothers (more likely to work the closer they are to the {#7}Orc Warlord{/#7})
units.zh: {#1}战吼{/#1}提高附近友军的{#2}士气{/#2}，减少其累积的{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}疲劳，同时降低附近佣兵的{#6}士气{/#6}。佣兵越靠近{#7}兽人军阀{/#7}，受影响的概率越高。

units.source: {#1}Weave Web{/#1} will throw a web on enemies, preventing movement, reducing their {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}, {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} and {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} by 50% (has a cooldown of 3 turns)
{#1}Whip{/#1} will set the morale of one goblin to "confident", if the goblin was fleeing it will only be set to "steady" (has a range of 5 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}鞭击{/#1}将一名地精的士气设为“斗志昂扬”；若其原本正在溃逃，则只恢复至“镇定”。技能距离为 5 格。

units.source: {#1}Wolf Bite{/#1} does 20-40 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 40% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 15% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} ({#11}Goblin Wolfriders{/#11} can use it only once per turn and it costs 0 AP for them)
Perk Skills can be learned by acquiring the corresponding Perk.
units.zh: 学习对应特长后，即可获得相应的特长技能。

units.source: Gain {#1}+2000{/#1} {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} Initiative for the next turn. The bonus {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} Initiative only counts towards the turn order. Character attracts slightly more attention from enemies.
Allows to move while being in the enemy Zone of Control or to leave it without triggering opportunity attacks.
units.zh: 允许在敌方控制区域内移动或离开该区域，而不触发借机攻击。

units.source: Grants a {#1}50%{/#1} {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} damage reduction and immunity to being {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}stunned{/#8}, knocked back or grabbed for one turn. The character attracts less attention from opponents.

Triggers a morale check to raise morale of any ally at wavering or worse morale within 4 tiles, with a bonus of 40% of the skill user's {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Resolve, and a penalty of -10 per tile of distance, to the roll. It can also rally fleeing allies within the same range at no penalty.
units.zh: 使 4 格内士气为“动摇”或更低的友军进行一次提高士气的检定。检定获得相当于施放者意志{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} 40% 的加成，并承受每格距离 -10 的惩罚。同一范围内正在溃逃的友军也可被重振士气，且不受这一惩罚。

units.source: Allows to reduce accumulated {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Fatigue by {#4}50%{/#4} by resting for the current turn.
Allows two characters to switch places while ignoring Zone of Control as long as neither character is stunned, rooted or otherwise disabled.
units.zh: 允许两名角色无视控制区域交换位置，前提是双方均未眩晕、被定身或处于其他无法行动的状态。

units.source: Allows to force the targeted opponent (at the maximum range of 3) take offensive actions instead of defensive ones, and attack the taunting character over another, potentially more vulnerable one.
units.zh: 对最远 3 格处的敌人使用，使其优先采取进攻而非防御行动，并攻击嘲讽者，而不是其他可能更脆弱的目标。

units.source: Gives the targeted indebted the 'Whipped' status effect, increasing many of their stats for 2 rounds. The higher the level of the character using this skill, the higher the increase.{#1/}Resets the morale of the targeted indebted to 'Steady' if currently below.{#2/}Inflicts {#3}1-3{/#3} HP damage that ignores armor to the target.
units.zh: 使目标负债者获得“受鞭笞”状态，提高多项属性，持续 2 轮。施放者等级越高，加成越大。{#1/}若目标士气低于“镇定”，将其恢复至“镇定”。{#2/}对目标造成 {#3}1-3{/#3} 点无视护甲的生命值伤害。

units.source: Can get a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} good mood for being violent. ({#4}Traveling Troupe{/#4})
Will get a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} bad mood if you set the alp free. ({#4}Alp Captured in a Hole{/#4})

New recruits to your mercenary company may have 0 to 2 randomly selected traits that affect their stats in positive and/or negative ways. Some backgrounds will disallow certain traits, as will some traits disallow others.{#1/} For example, a character can not be both physically strong and weak, or eagle-eyed and short-sighted.
units.zh: 加入战团的新兵可能随机拥有 0 至 2 项特性，对属性产生正面或负面影响。部分背景不会出现某些特性，部分特性之间也互相排斥。{#1/}例如，同一个角色不可能既强壮又虚弱，也不可能既目光锐利又近视。

units.source: Also, traits can allow certain events to trigger or certain new options for other events. Occasionally, new traits (such as "Fat") can be suffered through events or certain event choices.
units.zh: 特性还可能触发特定事件，或为其他事件提供新选项。有时，事件及其选项也会使角色获得新的特性，例如“肥胖”。

units.source: For a list of events associated with one or more specific Trait(s), look {#1}here{/#1}.
units.zh: 与一种或多种特性相关的事件列表，见{#1}这里{/#1}。

units.source: The debuff is only active when you stop cosuming potions for 7 days.
units.zh: 只有连续 7 天不再服用药剂后，这项减益才会生效。

units.source: Can lose this trait after not drinking potions for 14 or more days. ({#1}Lose Addiction{/#1})
units.zh: 连续至少 14 天不服用药剂后，有机会失去此特性。（{#1}戒除药瘾{/#1}）

units.source: You can become an addict if you consume drugs at least 4 times and at least once in the last 3 days. ({#1}Gain Addiction{/#1})
units.zh: 服药至少 4 次，且最近 3 天内至少服用过一次，就可能染上药瘾。（{#1}染上药瘾{/#1}）

units.source: May destroy 1 Treasure or Trophy or be punished to remove the trait. ({#1}Addict Steals Potion{/#1})
units.zh: 可能毁掉 1 件财宝或战利品，也可能因受到惩罚而失去此特性。（{#1}药瘾者偷药{/#1}）

units.source: May have the ({#1}Alp Nightmare 2{/#1}) event that is indistinguishable from the ({#2}Addict Steals Potion{/#2}) one. This event will claim to kill the brother, but you will realize that he is alive and it was just a dream.
units.zh: 可能触发{#1}梦魇噩梦 2{/#1}事件，其表面情节与{#2}药瘾者偷药{/#2}完全相同。事件会说这名佣兵已经死去，但随后你会发现他仍活着，一切只是一场梦。

units.source: Can be removed by a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}monk{/#4} or {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}beast slayer{/#8} brother. ({#9}Ailing Recovers{/#9})
Can be removed or replaced with other traits by an {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}anatomist{/#4}. ({#5}Anatomist vs Ailing{/#5})
You gain this trait by winning 5 fights in the {#1}Arena{/#1}.
units.zh: 在{#1}竞技场{/#1}赢得 5 场战斗后获得此特性。

units.source: Also displays the number of arena fights and wins.
units.zh: 同时显示竞技场参战场次与获胜场次。

units.source: Will be replaced by {#1}Arena Veteran{/#1} after winning 12 arena fights.
units.zh: 在竞技场赢得 12 场战斗后，替换为{#1}竞技老将{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}+50%{/#1} chance to survive if struck down and not killed by a fatality.
units.zh: 被击倒但未遭到致命终结时，存活概率 {#1}+50%{/#1}。

units.source: You gain this trait by winning 12 fights in the {#1}Arena{/#1}.
units.zh: 在{#1}竞技场{/#1}赢得 12 场战斗后获得此特性。

units.source: The base {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} recovery is 15 / turn, this trait reduces it to 12 / turn.
units.zh: 基础疲劳{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}恢复量为每回合 15 点，此特性使其降低至每回合 12 点。

units.source: Will always get {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Exhausted{/#4} in the ({#5}Combat Drill{/#5}) event.
This trait can be removed or replaced by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Iron Lungs{/#4} and 2 random traits. ({#5}Anatomist vs Asthmatic{/#5})

Will never become {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Exhausted{/#4} from ranged training and is 50% less likely to be {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Exhausted{/#8} from fatigue/initiative training. ({#9}Combat Drill{/#9})
Crushing and slashing damage can cause fatalities, piercing can't.
units.zh: 钝击和斩击可以造成致命终结，穿刺攻击则不能。

units.source: to the head with a slashing weapon cause decapitation.
units.zh: 斩击武器命中头部时，可能造成斩首。

units.source: to the head with a crushing weapon cause a smashed head.
units.zh: 钝击武器命中头部时，可能击碎头颅。

units.source: to the body with a slashing weapon cause disembowelment.
units.zh: 斩击武器命中身体时，可能造成开膛。

units.source: The decapitation or smashed head prevents {#1}Wiedergangers{/#1} from rising from the dead, but does not prevent {#2}Fallen Heroes{/#2} from raising on their own accord or being reanimated by {#3}Necromancers{/#3}.
units.zh: 斩首或击碎头颅可以阻止{#1}行尸{/#1}复活，但无法阻止{#2}陨落英雄{/#2}自行复活，或被{#3}亡灵法师{/#3}重新唤起。

units.source: Can't gain the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Fear of Beasts{/#4} trait. ({#5}Fear Beasts{/#5})
Can't gain the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Fear of Greenskins{/#4} trait. ({#5}Fear Greenskins{/#5})
Can't gain the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Fear of Undead{/#4} trait. ({#5}Fear Undead{/#5})
Can get a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} good mood raiding a farm. ({#4}Raid Farmstead{/#4})
Can help to remove the dastard trait from another brother. ({#1}Dastard Loses Trait{/#1})
units.zh: 可帮助另一名佣兵摆脱胆小鬼特性。（{#1}懦夫变勇敢{/#1}）

units.source: Can gain a mood boost if you have a dumb brother. ({#1}Bright vs Dumb{/#1})
units.zh: 若战团中有迟钝的佣兵，可能获得心情提升。（{#1}聪慧者与迟钝者{/#1}）

units.source: Can't join the ({#1}Archery Stunt{/#1}), ({#2}Gambler vs Other{/#2}), ({#3}Herbs Along the Way{/#3}) or ({#4}Strength Contest{/#4}) event.
units.zh: 不会参与{#1}箭术表演{/#1}、{#2}赌徒与其他佣兵{/#2}、{#3}沿途草药{/#3}或{#4}比拼力气{/#4}事件。

units.source: This trait can work very well with certain weapons (e.g. flails, axes, pikes) and synergizes well with the {#1}juggler{/#1} and {#2}killer on the run{/#2} backgrounds (due to their bonus chance to hit the head).
units.zh: 此特性很适合连枷、斧和长枪等武器，也能与{#1}杂耍艺人{/#1}及{#2}在逃杀人犯{/#2}背景配合，因为这两个背景具有额外头部命中概率。

units.source: Is not affected by fresh injuries sustained during the current battle.
units.zh: 不受本场战斗中新获得的伤势影响。

units.source: Can be removed by an {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Anatomist{/#4}. ({#5}Anatomist vs Clubfooted{/#5})
100% more likely to get injured in the ({#1}Combat Drill{/#1}) event.
units.zh: 在{#1}战斗操练{/#1}事件中，受伤概率提高 100%。

units.source: Can lose a breath holding contest against a character with iron lungs. ({#1}Cocky vs Iron Lungs{/#1})
units.zh: 可能在憋气比赛中输给拥有铁肺特性的佣兵。（{#1}自负者与铁肺{/#1}）

units.source: May claim to be a better leader than you are. ({#1}Cocky Challenges Player{/#1})
units.zh: 可能声称自己比你更适合担任队长。（{#1}自负者挑战队长{/#1}）

units.source: May get +1 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} and 50% of your brothers get a {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} good mood in ({#7}Cow Tipping{/#7}).
Can't gain the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Hate for Greenskins{/#4} trait. ({#5}Hate Greenskins{/#5})
Can't gain the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Hate for Undead{/#4} trait. ({#5}Hate Undead{/#5})
Will always get a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} bad mood in ({#4}Petrified Scream{/#4}).
He can boost the mood of other brothers if he also has the {#1}Fearless{/#1} trait. ({#2}Uber Courageous{/#2})
units.zh: 若同时拥有{#1}无畏{/#1}特性，可提升其他佣兵的心情。（{#2}超凡勇气{/#2}）

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4/}Starts combat at confident morale if his mood permits it.
He can boost the mood of other brothers. ({#1}Determined Delivers Peptalk{/#1})
units.zh: 可提升其他佣兵的心情。（{#1}坚定佣兵鼓舞士气{/#1}）

units.source: He can boost the mood of other brothers if he also has the {#1}Fearless{/#1} trait. ({#2}Uber Courageous{/#2})
units.zh: 若同时拥有{#1}无畏{/#1}特性，可提升其他佣兵的心情。（{#2}勇气过人{/#2}）

units.source: 50% less likely to get injured in the ({#1}Combat Drill{/#1}) event.
units.zh: 在{#1}战斗操练{/#1}事件中，受伤概率降低 50%。

units.source: 20% less likely to get injured in the ({#1}Mountains Are Dangerous{/#1}) event.
units.zh: 在{#1}山中险境{/#1}事件中，受伤概率降低 20%。

units.source: A brother can gain this trait when you refuse to give higher pay. ({#1}Greedy Demands Raise{/#1})
units.zh: 拒绝为佣兵加薪时，他可能获得此特性。（{#1}贪婪者要求加薪{/#1}）

units.source: He may lose a random item, punishing him for this might remove this trait. ({#1}Drunkard Loses Stuff{/#1})
units.zh: 可能弄丢一件随机物品；因此惩罚他时，有机会移除此特性。（{#1}酒鬼丢东西{/#1}）

units.source: A brother can gain this trait if you lose some brothers. ({#1}Oldguard Becomes Drunkard{/#1})
units.zh: 战团有佣兵阵亡后，其他佣兵可能获得此特性。（{#1}老兵借酒浇愁{/#1}）

units.source: Can gain a mood boost if you have a bright brother. ({#1}Bright vs Dumb{/#1})
units.zh: 若战团中有聪慧的佣兵，可能获得心情提升。（{#1}聪慧者与迟钝者{/#1}）

units.source: Can be removed by a {#1}historian{/#1} or {#2}monk{/#2} brother. ({#3}Education{/#3})
Can try to scare off unholds in ({#1}Scare Unholds{/#1}).
units.zh: 可在{#1}吓退巨魔{/#1}事件中尝试吓走巨魔。

units.source: This trait does NOT allow one to shoot further with a ranged weapon than normal.
units.zh: 此特性不会让远程武器射得更远。

units.source: It negates 1 point of vision penalty from nighttime or helmets.
units.zh: 可抵消夜间或头盔造成的 1 点视野惩罚。

units.source: He may get a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} bad mood after a recent battle that had casualties. ({#4}Fainthearted is Shellshocked{/#4})
Will get a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} bad mood in the ({#4}Flagellation Horrifies Other{/#4}) event.
Can be gained upon the ({#1}Glutton Gets Fat{/#1}) event.
units.zh: 可在{#1}贪食者发胖{/#1}事件中获得。

units.source: Can be removed. ({#1}Fat Guy Gets Fit{/#1}) (you lose the +10 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} too in that case)
units.zh: 可在{#1}肥胖佣兵减重{/#1}事件中移除，但同时也会失去 +10 生命值{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}加成。

units.source: Can injure himself and entertain your men. ({#1}Sled Race{/#1})
units.zh: 可能摔伤自己，同时给同伴带来乐趣。（{#1}雪橇比赛{/#1}）

units.zh: 使用{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}皮水囊{/#4}可移除年迈特性，并防止剑术大师再次衰老。

units.source: Can improve the brothers mood after losing a battle. ({#1}Optimist Lost Battle{/#1})
units.zh: 战败后可改善佣兵们的心情。（{#1}乐观者面对败仗{/#1}）

units.zh: 战斗获胜后仍可能获得坏心情。（{#1}悲观者面对胜仗{/#1}）

units.source: Can't gain a good mood in ({#1}Optimist Lost Battle{/#1}).
units.zh: 在{#1}乐观佣兵面对败仗{/#1}事件中，不会获得好心情。

units.zh: 可在{#5}不祥之兆{/#5}或{#6}恶毒诅咒{/#6}事件中陷入{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}畏惧{/#4}状态。迷信的佣兵完成{#7}猎杀女巫{/#7}委托中的战斗后，也有 20% 概率陷入畏惧。

units.source: He gets a permanent injury each time because he is struck down.
units.zh: 每次被击倒后存活，都会获得一项永久伤势。

units.source: This is calculated after regular hit chance, if a brother with 100 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} attacks an ally with 50 {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4}, teamplayer reduces it to 25, making it 25%. Surround bonus works against you in a friendly fire case.
units.zh: 此效果在普通命中率计算完毕后生效。例如，近战命中为 100 的佣兵{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}攻击近战防御为 50 的友军{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4}时，“团队精神”会将命中率降至 25，即 25%。发生误伤时，敌方包围加成反而会提高你命中友军的概率。

units.source: The positive effect is applied for both melee and ranged attacks.
units.zh: 这一有利效果同时适用于近战和远程攻击。

units.source: Injuries are (mostly) negative status effects inflicted upon getting {#1}hit{/#1} for a certain amount of {#2}damage{/#2} by regular attacks or sustained after some {#3}events{/#3}. Injuries can be temporary or permanent.{#4}{#5}{#6}[{/#6}1{#7}]{/#7}{/#5}{/#4}
units.zh: 伤势大多是不利状态，通常由普通攻击{#1}命中{/#1}并造成一定{#2}伤害{/#2}后产生，也可能源自某些{#3}事件{/#3}。伤势分为暂时伤势和永久伤势。{#4}{#5}{#6}[{/#6}1{#7}]{/#7}{/#5}{/#4}

units.source: Temporary injuries are short-term disabilities sustained in battle or after certain {#1}events{/#1}.
units.zh: 暂时伤势是在战斗或某些{#1}事件{/#1}中受到的短期伤害与功能损伤。

units.source: Successful attacks can inflict injuries if these conditions are met:

units.source: Some enemies can get injured, but are not affected by injuries:
units.zh: 某些敌人虽然可以受伤，却不会受到伤势效果影响：

units.source: The {#1}Iron Will Potion{/#1} makes brothers not affected by injuries and immune to new temporary injuries for the duration of a battle.
units.zh: {#1}钢铁意志药剂{/#1}可使佣兵在一场战斗中不受伤势影响，并免疫新产生的暂时伤势。

units.source: If the base conditions are satisfied, a random injury of a type that depends on the weapon used is selected among possible candidates. All candidates have the same chance to be selected (no distinction is made between light and heavy injuries for instance). This is the formula used to determine if a specific injury can be inflicted:
units.zh: 满足基础条件后，系统会根据所用武器，从所有符合条件的伤势中随机选取一种。各候选伤势的概率相同，例如不会另行区分轻伤和重伤的出现权重。判断某项伤势能否产生时，使用以下公式：

units.source: Injuries have different thresholds comprised between 25% and 60% of maximum hitpoints (see the list for specific values). They usually indicate how serious an injury is and how much damage is required for them to appear. The base threshold is modified by several multipliers (default value = 1).
units.zh: 不同伤势的伤害门槛介于生命值上限的 25% 至 60% 之间，具体数值见下表。门槛通常反映伤势的严重程度，以及造成它所需的伤害量。基础门槛还会受到数个倍率修正，这些倍率的默认值 = 1。

units.source: the injury threshold multiplier is not currently modified by anything
units.zh: 目前，没有效果会改变伤势门槛倍率。

units.source: the inflict injury threshold multiplier is modified by the Crippling Strikes {#1}perk{/#1} which sets it at 0.66 effectively reducing the threshold by 33%
units.zh: 致残打击{#1}特长{/#1}将造成伤势的门槛倍率设为 0.66，相当于把门槛降低 33%。

units.source: the receive injury threshold multiplier is modified by the Iron Jaw {#1}trait{/#1} which sets it at 1.25 effectively raising the threshold by 25%
units.zh: 铁下巴{#1}特性{/#1}将承受伤势的门槛倍率设为 1.25，相当于把门槛提高 25%。

units.source: the bonus multiplier is set to 1.25 if the head was hit (critical hits deal more damage)
units.zh: 命中头部时，额外倍率设为 1.25，因为暴击会造成更多伤害。

units.source: The result is compared to the relative amount of hitpoints lost. So reducing incoming {#1}damage{/#1} or increasing the maximum amount of hitpoints helps avoid injuries. Suffering an injury will cause a mood drop.
units.zh: 最终结果会与本次损失的生命值占比比较。因此，降低受到的{#1}伤害{/#1}或提高生命值上限，都有助于避免受伤。获得伤势也会降低心情。

units.source: {#1}bandages{/#1} for hemorrhaging injuries (Grazed Neck, Cut Neck Vein, Cut Artery) but only during the battle they were sustained
units.zh: {#1}绷带{/#1}可处理颈部擦伤、颈静脉割伤和动脉割伤等出血伤势，但只限于受伤的这场战斗中。

units.source: in a settlement temple for a price (see below)
units.zh: 在聚落的神殿付费治疗，详见下文。

units.source: Injuries that have not been treated can fester ({#1}Wound Gets Infected{/#1}).
units.zh: 未经治疗的伤口可能化脓。（{#1}伤口感染事件{/#1}）

units.source: These injuries are not sustained through the usual means.
units.zh: 以下伤势并非通过通常的受伤机制获得。

units.zh: 伤口感染只会在{#1}伤口感染事件{/#1}事件后出现。

units.zh: 同样，疾病也只会由某些特定事件引发，详见下文。服用药剂或{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}奇异蘑菇{/#4}可能使角色{#5}患病{/#5}。

units.zh: {#1}疾病缠身，这个角色浑身不适，几乎无法作战。如果高烧没有夺去他的性命，过些时日应该会好起来。{/#1}

Surviving with the 'Partly Collapsed Lung' permanent injury (after battle screen)
units.zh: 带着“部分肺塌陷”永久伤势存活，图为战后结算界面。

units.source: Permanent injuries are incurable disabilities received after having been struck down in battle or rarely after experiencing certain {#1}events{/#1}. Consuming the {#2}Water Skin{/#2} legendary item is the only way to remove a permanent injury. Suffering a permanent injury aggravates mood.
units.zh: 永久伤势是在战斗中被击倒后留下的终身损伤，极少数也可能由特定{#1}事件{/#1}造成。通常无法治愈，使用传奇物品{#2}皮水囊{/#2}是移除永久伤势的唯一方法。永久伤势会进一步恶化心情。

units.source: A character whose hitpoints have reached 0 has a chance of surviving with a random permanent injury an otherwise fatal blow. Surviving is not possible if:
units.zh: 角色生命值降至 0 时，有机会从本应致命的攻击中活下来，但会获得一项随机永久伤势。以下情况无法幸存：

units.source: the damage was self inflicted (result of an effect like bleeding, poison, etc.)
units.zh: 伤害来自自身持续效果，例如流血、中毒等。

units.source: The chance to survive is 33% or 90% with the Survivor {#1}trait{/#1}. The part hit does not matter in selecting the injury. For example it's possible to get Brain Damage after a body hit.
units.zh: 通常的幸存概率为 33%；拥有幸存者{#1}特性{/#1}时为 90%。永久伤势的种类与被命中的部位无关，例如身体中招也可能留下脑损伤。

units.source: If a character survives, the combat log will display 'struck down' instead of 'killed' or 'died'. Surviving characters cannot be eaten by Nachzehrers or reanimated as Wiedergangers.
units.zh: 若角色幸存，战斗日志会显示“被击倒”，而非“被杀死”或“死亡”。幸存角色不会被食尸鬼吞食，也不会被复活成行尸。

Caused by the {#1}Combat Drill{/#1}, {#2}Desert Bugbite{/#2}, {#3}Desert Heat{/#3}, {#4}Good Nights Sleep{/#4}, {#5}Lend Men to Build{/#5} and {#6}Nightowl Catches Thief{/#6} event.
When this status is removed there is a 50% chance to get the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Hangover{/#4} status.

Caused by {#1}Knock Out (25 fatigue){/#1}/{#2}(30 fatigue){/#2}, {#3}Knock Over (30 fatigue){/#3}, {#4}Strike Down (30 fatigue){/#4}, {#5}Pound (15 fatigue){/#5} or {#6}Thresh (35 fatigue){/#6} attack, by the {#7}Charge (25 fatigue){/#7} skill of {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} {#11}Orcs{/#11} and the {#12}Unstoppable Charge (30 fatigue){/#12} of {#13}{#14}{#15/}{/#14}{/#13} {#16}Unholds{/#16} and by the {#17}Tail Slam Split (25 fatigue){/#17}, {#18}Tail Slam Sweep (20 fatigue){/#18}, {#19}Tail Slam Thresh (25 fatigue){/#19} of {#20}{#21}{#22/}{/#21}{/#20} {#23}Lindwurms{/#23}.
If stunned by {#1}Strike Down (30 fatigue){/#1}, the effect duration is 2 turns.
units.zh: 若由{#1}重击击晕（30点疲劳）{/#1}造成眩晕，效果持续 2 回合。

units.source: Someone that is stunned has no zone of control, can't be rotated out and is not contributing to surround bonus.
units.zh: 眩晕单位不会施加控制区域，无法被换位移走，也不会提供包围加成。

units.source: The bonus initiative only counts towards the turn order.
units.zh: 这部分额外先攻只用于计算行动顺序。

units.source: Caused by the {#1}Bad Omen{/#1} or {#2}Bad Curse{/#2} event and there is a 20% chance that a {#3}Superstitious{/#3} brother becomes afraid after combat in a {#4}Hunting Hexen{/#4} contract.
units.zh: 由{#1}不祥之兆{/#1}或{#2}恶毒诅咒{/#2}事件引起。{#3}迷信{/#3}的佣兵完成{#4}猎杀女巫{/#4}委托中的战斗后，也有 20% 概率陷入畏惧状态。

units.source: There is a 25% chance to lose this status when a new day starts.
units.zh: 每天开始时，有 25% 概率移除此状态。

units.source: Caused by losing at least 6 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} from {#4}Cleave (12 fatigue){/#4}, {#5}Whip (15 fatigue){/#5}, {#6}Cleave (15 fatigue){/#6} attacks of 1- and 2-handed {#7}Cleavers{/#7}, the {#8}Rupture (12 fatigue){/#8} attack of {#9}Jagged Pikes{/#9}, the {#10}Hyena Bite (6 fatigue){/#10} of {#11}Hyenas{/#11} and the {#12}Bite (10 fatigue){/#12} of {#13}Irrlichts{/#13}.
Cleavers and Whips deal 10 bleed damage per stack if the attacker has the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Cleaver Mastery{/#4}.
units.zh: 若攻击者拥有{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}斩刀精通{/#4}，斩刀和鞭子施加的每层流血伤害提高至 10 点。

units.source: Other enemies that accompany a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Hexe{/#4} have this status effect.
The status ends on the start of your turn if the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Hexe{/#4} is dead or at the end of your turn if the duration ended.
units.zh: 若{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}女巫{/#4}已死亡，状态会在你的回合开始时解除；若持续时间自然结束，则在你的回合结束时解除。

units.source: Caused by the {#1}Spirit Walk{/#1} skill of the {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Ijirok{/#5}.
Switching to another weapon will remove this status immediately.
units.zh: 切换到其他武器会立即移除此状态。

units.source: This status only applies if you have a one-handed weapon equipped with your second hand free i.e. no shield or net.
units.zh: 只有装备单手武器、另一只手空着时才会生效，也就是副手没有盾牌或投网等物品。

units.source: Does not apply for {#1}Puncture (20 fatigue){/#1} skill, but it does apply for regular dagger {#2}Stab (7 fatigue){/#2}.
units.zh: 不适用于{#1}破甲刺击（20点疲劳）{/#1}，但适用于匕首的普通{#2}刺击（7点疲劳）{/#2}。

units.source: Target is rooted, can't move, unable to use skills and is dragged towards Kraken's maw.
units.zh: 目标被定身，无法移动或使用技能，并被拖向克拉肯的巨口。

units.source: Chance to Break Free or Free Ally is based on {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} with -10 points penalty.
units.zh: 挣脱或解救友军的成功率以近战命中{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}为基础，并承受 -10 点惩罚。

units.source: Caused by someone that is holding a{#1/}{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Battle Standard{/#5}.
{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4/}You will take the same damage as the {#5}Hexe{/#5}
Lasts till the start of Hexe's turn on the next round.
units.zh: 持续至下一轮女巫的回合开始。

units.source: A brother can't have more than 1 Hex on him at the same time.
units.zh: 同一名佣兵同时最多只能受到 1 个咒缚。

units.source: The AI will still know that you are inside the grass.
units.zh: AI 仍然知道你藏在草丛中。

units.source: You will be visible with opponents standing directly adjacent to you and if you order an attack.
units.zh: 敌人与你直接相邻，或你下令发动攻击时，就会暴露身形。

units.source: You can still get hit by projectiles aimed at someone directly behind you or any scattering shot.
units.zh: 瞄准你身后相邻目标的投射物，以及散射攻击，仍可能击中你。

units.source: Caused by the {#1}Horror{/#1} skill of an {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Ancient Priest{/#5}.
Someone that is horrified has no zone of control, can't be rotated out and is not contributing to surround bonus.
units.zh: 处于惊恐状态的单位不会施加控制区域，无法被换位移走，也不会提供包围加成。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4/}This character is immune to any kind of poison.
Grants immunity to being {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}stunned{/#4}, knocked back or grabbed.
Caused by the {#1}Throw Fire Pot (20 fatigue){/#1} skill of a {#2}Fire Pot{/#2} to a tile.
units.zh: 使用{#2}燃烧罐{/#2}的{#1}投掷燃烧罐（20点疲劳）{/#1}技能，使目标地块燃烧。

units.source: You can walk through the burning tile or wait on the tile without taking damage.
units.zh: 穿过燃烧地块，或在该地块上选择等待，不会立即受到伤害。

units.source: Does 300% damage to {#1}Schrats{/#1}, 33% damage to enemies with {#2}Resistant to Ranged Attacks{/#2} perk and 66% damage to {#3}Serpents{/#3} or units wearing a {#4}Body Armor{/#4} with the {#5}Serpent Skin Mantle{/#5} attachment.{#6/}({#7}These reductions dont affect armor damage yet, only HP ones.{/#7})
units.zh: 对{#1}树妖{/#1}造成 300% 伤害；对拥有{#2}远程攻击抗性{/#2}的敌人造成 33% 伤害；对{#3}巨蛇{/#3}，或穿着装有{#5}巨蛇皮披肩{/#5}附件的{#4}身体护甲{/#4}的单位，造成 66% 伤害。{#6/}（{#7}这些减免目前仅影响生命值伤害，不影响护甲伤害。{/#7}）

units.source: {#1}Ifrits{/#1}, {#2}Geists{/#2} and other ghosts units are totally immune.
units.zh: {#1}沙魔{/#1}、{#2}怨魂{/#2}及其他幽灵类单位完全免疫。

units.source: Snow or shallow water terrain can not be set on fire, but the immediate damage tick from throwing a fire pot will always apply.
units.zh: 积雪和浅水地块无法点燃，但投掷燃烧罐时的即时伤害仍会生效。

units.source: This status overwrites other effects from the original tile.
units.zh: 此状态会覆盖该地块原有的其他效果。

units.source: Can be applied to multiple targets with a single attack.
units.zh: 一次攻击可以同时对多个目标施加此效果。

units.source: Caused by losing at least 6 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} from melee and ranged attacks of {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Goblin Ambushers{/#7}.
You can also apply this poison to your weapons with the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Goblin Poison{/#4} consumable.
units.zh: 也可以使用消耗品{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}地精毒液{/#4}，将这种毒涂在自己的武器上。

units.source: Each hit, which applies poison, resets the status effect to a maximum (duration).
units.zh: 每次成功施毒的命中，都会将状态的持续时间重置为最大值。

units.source: Each bite, which applies poison, resets the status effect duration to a maximum.
units.zh: 每次成功施毒的撕咬，都会将状态的持续时间重置为最大值。

units.source: You can also apply this poison to your weapons with the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Poisoned Oil{/#4} consumable.
units.zh: 也可以使用消耗品{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}淬毒油{/#4}，将这种毒涂在自己的武器上。

units.source: The crafted {#1}Poisoned Oil{/#1} deals 10 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} damage to affected targets.
Each weapon hit, which applies poison, causes the effect to stack.
units.zh: 每次成功施毒的武器命中，都会叠加这一效果。

units.source: Caused by the {#1}Possess Undead{/#1} skill of a {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Necromancer{/#5}.
Stunning or killing the possessed undead or the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Necromancer{/#4} ends this status immediately.
units.zh: 击晕或杀死被附身的亡灵，或施术的{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}亡灵法师{/#4}，都会立即结束此状态。

units.source: Dealing at least 10 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} of damage in a single hit to the {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Necromancer{/#7} will end the status as well.
You also have no more {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} checks triggered on losing {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4}.
A character can only be rallied once per turn.
units.zh: 每名角色每回合只能被重振士气一次。

units.source: Negative stats effect gradually fades, by 5% less each turn.
units.zh: 属性惩罚逐回合减弱，每回合减少 5%。

units.source: Character can be forcibly awoken by allies and will wake up when taking any amount of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} damage.
units.zh: 友军可以主动唤醒该角色；受到任意生命值伤害{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}时，也会醒来。

units.source: The higher a character's {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}, the higher the chance to resist the urge to sleep.
{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Rally{/#4} can be used to wake your men up.
The {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Kraken{/#4} will take only 10% armor damage from acid.
{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4/}You take {#5}10%{/#5} {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} of the current armor value after your turn
Unit that hits a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Lindwurm{/#4} for more than 10 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} damage gets sprayed with acid only if he stands right next to the beast part which he hits.
units.zh: 单次攻击对{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}林德蠕龙{/#4}造成超过 10 点生命值伤害{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}时，只有站在被击中部位紧旁的攻击者才会被酸液溅中。

units.source: Each acid spray resets status effect duration back to maximum.
units.zh: 每次酸液喷溅都会将状态的持续时间重置为最大值。

units.source: Caused by the {#1}Swarm of Insects{/#1} skill of a {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Goblin Shaman{/#5}.
Caused by the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Throwing Net{/#4} and the {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Reinforced Throwing Net{/#8} consumable.

Chance to remove net is based on {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} with -10 points penalty for the {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Throwing Net{/#7} and -25 points penalty for the {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} {#11}Reinforced Throwing Net{/#11}.
Each failed attempt to Break Free or Free Ally adds +10 points for subsequent attempts to remove net.
units.zh: 每次挣脱或解救友军失败后，后续移除投网的尝试都会获得 +10 点成功率加成。

units.source: Caused by the {#1}Root{/#1} skill of a {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Goblin Shaman{/#5}.
Caused by the {#1}Weave Web{/#1} skill of a {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Webknecht{/#5}.
You are also 50% more likely to be the target of attacks.
units.zh: 成为敌人攻击目标的概率也会提高 50%。

units.source: Your chance to remove web is your melee skill with -10 points penalty.
units.zh: 挣脱蛛网的概率以近战命中为基础，并承受 -10 点惩罚。

units.source: Each failed attempt to Break Free or Free Ally adds +10 points to remove net.
units.zh: 每次挣脱或解救友军失败后，移除网的尝试都会获得 +10 点成功率加成。
